name: 구동사) "take you up on" || 제안이나 초대를 받아들일 때

keywords.en: A: Oh ~ Wow! I really like your space. It’s really cozy.
B: Well, I spend a lot of time here.
I wanted it to be comfotable.
You’re welcome to come by any time (you want), by the way.
keywords.ko: 너가 원할 떄 언제든 들러도 좋아

keywords.en: A: Are you sure? You’re not just saying that?
B: No I really mean it.
A: Alright. Well, I might actually take you up on that.

keywords.ko: take (누구) up on (무엇) : (누가) 제안을 한 것을 (무엇) 대로 하다.

my_sentences.en: Could I take you up on that offer of a lift, Rob?
Since she'd offered to babysit, I took her up on it.
If you take someone up on their offer or invitation, you accept it.
